title: Lateen WCAG checks
description: Every WCAG 2.2 level A and AA success criterion, how the theme checks it, and the evidence behind a manual check. A criterion is linked, never copied, so the wording stays with the W3C. `checked` is present only when the date, the version, and the evidence exist; without it the checklist says the check is not recorded yet.

id.description: The criterion number, exactly as the W3C writes it.

principle.description: The principle the criterion belongs to, from the first digit of its number.

name.description: The criterion's short name, so a reader can find it.

url.description: The W3C's Understanding page for the criterion.

how.description: The primary way it is checked; `notes` carries a partial automated check.

notes.description: What is checked, or why the criterion does not apply.

evidence.description: A link to where the check is recorded.
